name: open-artifact
description: Make slide decks, design canvases, whiteboards, spreadsheets, data dashboards, docs, animated films, design systems and free HTML pages as folders of files that open in one local page where the person views, edits, comments and exports; comments sent from the page come back to the agent. /open-artifact <type> <what to make>. Needs Node.js 22 or later.

OPEN_ARTIFACT_SERVER.title: Open Artifact server
OPEN_ARTIFACT_SERVER.description: Optional. The address of an Open Artifact server to publish to instead of keeping artifacts only on this computer, such as https://artifacts.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:4900. Leave empty for local only. Takes effect when the Open Artifact daemon next starts.
